verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a Conversational Intelligence add-on that applies AI to calls, and an Agentic Voice AI platform that analyzes customer interactions. Neither item explicitly mentions summaries or transcripts, or says that outputs are attached to the call or conversation record. missing for 10: explicit AI call summaries, call transcripts, attachment of summaries/transcripts to the conversation or call log, depth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation

citations.quote: Conversational Intelligence Use AI insights to understand calls and improve sales conversations.
Agentic Voice AI platform to automate, assist, and analyze customer interactions end-to-end.
